summary.headline: DevX FY26 consolidated revenue reached INR226 crores (vs INR159 crores in FY25) with consolidated EBITDA of INR109 crores at a 48.4% margin.
summary.overview: Management reported FY26 consolidated revenue of INR226 crores, up from INR159 crores, with consolidated EBITDA of INR109 crores (48.4% margin). Standalone revenue was INR171 crores with a 60.5% EBITDA margin, and normalized standalone cash EBIT was INR36.55 crores (21.38%). Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue was INR59 crores, and the Ambli Bopal Capital One campus (3.15 lakh sq ft, 95% pre-leased) went live. Analysts pressed on the mature-centre occupancy definition change, the Q4 YoY revenue dip from closing a Noida asset, and lower brokerage share.

segments.name: Standalone managed workspace (core)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR171 crores at 60.5% EBITDA margin; normalized cash EBIT 21.38%. Enterprise built-to-suit contracts are 65% of revenue and co-working 6%.

segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR52.3 crores at 7.2% EBITDA margin; builds offices for DevX and external clients with a 75-90 day delivery commitment.

segments.commentary: Offers recruitment, payroll and HRMS to GCC clients; no financials disclosed on the call. Management and subsidiaries together were said to be 20-25% of revenue.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue run-rate guided at INR330-350 crores, with cash EBIT of 21-22%.
Capital One (0.3 million sq ft) to add about INR2.6-2.75 crores revenue per month from Q1 FY27.
Plan to invest INR200-225 crores over FY27-FY28 to grow operational area from 1.2 million sq ft to 3 million sq ft by FY28.
Target of 5-7 lakh sq ft of development management projects to be identified in the next 12 months.
Plan for development management partnerships in Indore, Jaipur, Surat and Baroda to be announced in FY27.
Q1 FY27 expected liquidity of INR110-120 crores from monetizing a stake in a subsidiary building about 0.5 million sq ft.
Rent-to-revenue above 2.2x, debt-to-equity below 1, and cash EBIT of 20-22% are stated hygiene metrics.
capex_capacity: Seats at 13,304 at end FY26, plus 4,000 added in Q4 FY26; management said about 17,500 seats today, with revenue from Q4 additions starting Q1 FY27.
Capital One campus (Ambli Bopal, Ahmedabad; 19 storeys, 3.15 lakh sq ft; 4,000 seats, 95% pre-leased) went live in Q4 and is EBITDA positive from day one.
Ambli Bopal 8.1 lakh sq ft development management asset: INR100 crores investment over four years, targeting INR120 crores annual revenue, 80% occupancy and 8,500 seats.

Winston asset of 4.5 lakh sq ft under straight lease, funded by INR35 crore preferential issue; Prestige partnership adds 1.1 lakh sq ft on Outer Ring Road, Bengaluru, with fit-outs from June 1 and revenue expected in August mid or end.

Pipeline: Million Minds (84,000 sq ft, Vaishnodevi), about 40,000 sq ft in Pune, 2 lakh sq ft Pune possession in Sep/Oct with revenue from January, and 0.5 million sq ft in Ahmedabad going live in Q4 FY27.
NCD plan of INR100 crores at 11-12% cost, issued as properties become ready; total deployment of INR220-230 crores over two years.
demand_pricing: Enterprise (built-to-suit) clients are 65% of revenue, with average lock-in of 34 months; 300+ clients, of which over 100 operate in multiple cities.
Management said it sees no demand-side pricing pressure; supply-side tile shortage from gas unavailability was temporary and has eased.
Development management fee of INR300-500 per sq ft over 2-4 years, paid by land owners; a 4 lakh sq ft asset implies INR12-20 crores to DevX.
Tier 2 share of portfolio is 65% and Tier 1 is 35%. Tier 2 GCC hiring is up 21% YoY, with 35% real estate cost arbitrage versus Tier 1.
Brokerage was lower as a share of revenue in FY26 because new-centre brokerage was front-loaded in earlier periods; 35% of Gujarat revenue and 50% outside Gujarat come via brokers.

qa_highlights.question: Why did mature-centre occupancy fall to about 70% from the 90s?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the mature-centre definition changed: earlier it was centres above 85% occupancy, and now 100% is the benchmark, with about 70% of mature centres at 100% across 0.83 million sq ft.

qa_highlights.question: Why did Q4 revenue fall YoY and why was the Noida asset closed?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the Noida asset was run by a land owner who failed to maintain common areas (elevators, AHUs), so DevX closed it; standalone margins were said to be flat to slightly better.

qa_highlights.question: Is there pricing pressure or competition?
qa_highlights.answer: No demand-side pressure was reported; supply-side constraints (tiles, labour, raw materials) eased after a short disruption.

qa_highlights.question: What are the FY27 revenue drivers and timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said H1 FY27 revenue comes from Capital One, Million Minds and a Pune asset; Q3 expected to be slower; Q4 boosted by 0.5 million sq ft in Ahmedabad.

qa_highlights.question: How will the Bengaluru expansion and NCD funds be used?
qa_highlights.answer: Bengaluru: 1.1 lakh sq ft with Prestige on Outer Ring Road; funding is INR100 crores NCDs plus INR110-120 crores liquidity and INR35 crore preferential issue, deployed over two years.

qa_highlights.question: Is AI a threat to IT-led office demand?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said current clients have not churned and it expects IT firms to keep hiring with AI-skilled staff; no quantified evidence was given.

risks_watch: Occupancy definition change: mature-centre occupancy now measured against 100%, with about 70% of mature centres at 100%. Disclosed occupancy will look lower than the previous 85% basis.
Execution of 3 million sq ft target by FY28 on INR200-225 crore capex, depending on the INR110-120 crore subsidiary stake sale in Q1 FY27 and NCD issuance.
Dependence on land-owner partners for development management projects, and the Noida closure shows service-quality risk from third-party operators.
Brokerage share and channel dependence outside Gujarat (50%) could affect margins.
Q3 FY27 flagged as slower for new revenue additions; ramp-up depends on Ahmedabad 0.5 million sq ft going live in Q4 FY27.
Management succession: plans to hire multi-city senior leadership and cited the promoters' hands-on role as a constraint for scale-up.
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on growth, the Tier 2 thesis and FY27 pipeline, with forward numbers given readily. Evasive or deflecting on the occupancy definition change, the Q4 YoY decline and the AI-related question, where answers were broad and did not quantify the impact.
key_quotes: So if I'm committing a 3 Million square feet of area in the next two years of time frame, how much are we adding on a quarter-on-quarter basis?
What we are committing is operational expertise and lease obligation against assets where we have already received a committed demand.
The asset is EBITDA positive from day one, and we would be achieving a revenue run rate of INR2.65 crores to INR2.75 crores per month.

growth.why: FY27 revenue run-rate guided at INR330-350 crore (vs FY26 INR226 consolidated, about 46% midpoint growth), backed by Capital One ramp (INR2.6-2.75 crore/month from Q1 FY27), Winston, Prestige and Pune pipeline, and a 1.2 to 3 mn sq ft expansion by FY28 funded by INR200-225 crore capex; utilisation is only 70% and occupied seats are stagnant, so backing is partial.
